name: Claude AI Content Generator
description: HTTP POST with a topic and content type triggers Claude to write a full blog post, newsletter, or social media content draft. Returns content via API and notifies via Slack.

setupVars.label: Slack channel the incoming webhook posted to

blockers.detail: Chat Model provider anthropic is not supported by the current node catalog

setup: "Generate Content": the original provider "anthropic" and model are preserved. Select a supported Chat Model provider and matching model, or add its adapter in Yantra before running.
"Trigger Webhook" (webhook) started the original; run this workflow on demand, through the workflow API, or add a schedule.
Setup value slackChannel: Slack channel the incoming webhook posted to (for example #alerts). Write it into the Workflow Configs initialContext before import.
Provide run inputs: body, query, headers, llm_system_bb7dcb2b0c.

hints: The original started from an inbound webhook (POST /generate-content). Run it with `cdecli workflow run <slug> --ver <version> -d '{"body": {...}}'` or through the workflow API.

"Generate Content" called the Anthropic API (claude-sonnet-4-6) over HTTP; it now runs on LLMChain with a Chat Model and provider connector credential, and later steps read the answer text instead of the provider's JSON.
"Notify via Slack" posted through a Slack incoming webhook; it now posts with the Slack connector to the channel in slackChannel.
Select the Project and Environment on the Workflow Configs node (the ids from `cdecli auth status`), then connect a credential for each connector below.
Connect slack: `cdecli credential create -n "slack" -p slack --template <formId> --secret <key>=<value>` (see `cdecli credential templates`).
